indicator.name: Teenage pregnancy, age 15–19
indicator.description: Percentage of women age 15–19 who have ever been pregnant in the 2022 Kenya Demographic and Health Survey.
indicator.expected_availability_note: Published for all 47 counties. KDHS 2022 county point estimate. The source-reported number of women age 15–19 is retained as survey precision metadata. Sensitive point-estimate ranking remains prohibited.
